sample_unit: mammography images/questions across four public datasets (EMBED, InBreast, CMMD, CBIS-DDSM)

links.outcome: GPT-5 mammogram performance compared with human experts and domain-specific fine-tuned models
links.effect: GPT-5 was best among GPT models but lagged human experts and fine-tuned models; sensitivity 63.5% and specificity 52.3% versus human expert estimates.
links.quote: Compared with human expert estimations, GPT-5 exhibited lower sensitivity (63.5%) and specificity (52.3%).

screen.reason: Evaluates multimodal foundation models (GPT-5, GPT-4o) on public mammogram VQA benchmarks for BI-RADS and malignancy classification without testing deployment practices or safeguards.
